name: Awaki Kotone
source:
A 19 year old new master who inherited the cafe 'Enchanté' from her dead grandfather.
She got a job after graduating high school and has some experience, so she understands the harshness of the world.
She's bright and optimistic however and adapts well to things. She's good at housework and cooking.
